sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt:
The table below shows the monthly expenditure of an average Australian family in 1991 and 2001. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. Australian dollar per month – 1991 Australian dollar per month – 2001 food 155 160 Electricity and gas 75 120 Clothing 30 20 Housing 95 100 Transport 70 45 Other goods and services 250 270 Total 675 715 Australian dollar per month – 1991 | Australian dollar per month – 2001
food | 155 | 160
Electricity and gas | 75 | 120
Clothing | 30 | 20
Housing | 95 | 100
Transport | 70 | 45
Other goods and services | 250 | 270
Total | 675 | 715
Individuals should improve the environment or is it the government and large companies that should take action? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
